derived_values.name: Previous bar MACD histogram
derived_values.used_by: Crossover detection (comparing current vs previous bar)

other_exits: Stop Loss and Take Profit only - no signal-based exit

custom_logic_notes: Waterline cross means MACD histogram crossing zero (i.e., MACD line crossing signal line). The EA name 'WaterlineCross' refers to the MACD histogram crossing the zero waterline. Digit adjustment: SL and TP input values are multiplied by 10 when _Digits==5 or _Point<0.001 (standard 5-digit broker adjustment). Entry uses previous bar values ([1]) for crossover detection to avoid repainting.
python_conversion_notes: Simple MACD zero-line crossover strategy. Use ta-lib or pandas-ta for MACD calculation. Entry: MACD histogram crosses above zero -> buy, crosses below zero -> sell. Use previous completed bar for signal to avoid look-ahead bias. Digit adjustment: if price has 5 decimal places, multiply SL/TP by 10. Ensure new-bar guard to trade only once per bar. Position gate: check for existing positions before entry.
